subject: Judge: review bin/install.js end-to-end installer expansion
description:
JUDGE TASK (skill: self-learn-judge, single-attempt review mode). Goes ready automatically when the impl task it is blocked_by completes. Review the impl attempt branch orch/attempt/<impl-key> for the task "Make @zonoid/core bin/install.js a self-sufficient end-to-end installer".

Invoke self-learn-judge in single-attempt review mode: fetch the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff), then apply the code-review rubric:
  - CORRECTNESS: skills symlink uses the linkSkill symlink→junction→copy fallback (Windows-safe); pre-push guard resolves hooks dir via `git rev-parse --git-path hooks` and does NOT clobber a foreign pre-push hook; CLAUDE.md append is idempotent (skips when orchestrator section present); workspace registration is best-effort (daemon-down never fails the install); --dry-run writes nothing for the new steps.
  - SCOPE DISCIPLINE: only bin/install.js + test/install.test.js touched; packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js NOT modified; existing JSON-writer behavior + flags preserved.
  - DEAD/REDUNDANT CODE, STYLE: matches the surrounding bin/install.js idiom (fwd-slash paths, console helpers, try/catch chmod).
  - TESTS: test/install.test.js present, covers linkSkill fallback branches, prePushTestCommand variants, foreign-hook non-overwrite, idempotent CLAUDE.md, dry-run no-write; `node scripts/run-tests.js` is green.

VERDICT: automode is OFF, so APPROVE = hold-merge (record the verdict via complete_task WITHOUT a merge action; the dispatcher makes the feature→main merge call). KICK BACK = set_status(<impl-key>, "failed") + a wired record_decision explaining what to fix. NEVER force-merge.

summary: APPROVE (hold-merge; automode off). Reviewed orch/attempt/...-1 diff (bin/install.js +280, test/install.test.js new +278). Scope clean: only the two intended files touched, packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js untouched; require.main===module guard + module.exports added so the file imports without running, and existing installMcp/installSettings behavior + all flags (--dry-run/--user/--workspace/--install-dir/--port) preserved. CORRECTNESS verified per rubric: linkSkill does symlink→junction→copy→null fallback (Windows-safe, no elevation, injectable for tests); installSkills idempotent (skips correct links / skill.md dirs, repairs broken/wrong); pre-push guard resolves hooks dir via `git rev-parse --git-path hooks` (worktree/core.hooksPath-safe, absolutizes) and only writes when marker-present/empty/absent — a FOREIGN hook is warned-and-preserved, never clobbered; installClaudeInstructions appends only when "Orchestrator dashboard" absent (idempotent); registerWorkspace is best-effort (req error/timeout resolve, never throw, DRY skips HTTP). Every new step is a verified no-op under --dry-run. Style matches surrounding idiom (fwd() paths, console.log prefix helpers, try/catch chmod). TESTS: ran `node test/install.test.js` in the impl worktree — 36/36 ok, exit 0; covers linkSkill junction/copy/total-failure/happy, prePushTestCommand test:all-vs-test-vs-none-vs-no-package.json, foreign-hook non-overwrite + idempotence, idempotent CLAUDE.md, and a spawned --dry-run E2E asserting zero files written. The 12 pre-existing run-tests.js failures are unrelated (reproduce on untouched main) and not penalized. Minor non-blocking: installSkills has no dedicated unit test, but its core (linkSkill) is exhaustively tested and the dry-run E2E exercises its no-write path. Dispatcher owns the feature→main merge.
